title: Go for Cloud-Native
prereqs: Docker + kind for the operator deploy challenge
Courses 1 & 9 help for the operator parts
description: Go as the language of the cloud-native world: types/slices/maps/interfaces, goroutines & channels & the concurrency model, errors, modules & tooling — then the Kubernetes client-go / controller-runtime stack, culminating in building, testing and deploying your own CRD + controller (operator) with kubebuilder. Each step is go-test-judged; the finale deploys to a kind cluster.
